stem.text: The infra-red spectra of three organic compounds are shown.

stem.label: spectrum 1
stem.alt: Infra-red spectrum 1: transmittance (%) against wavenumber (cm-1) from 4000 to 400, with sharp C–H peaks near 3000 cm-1 and strong peaks near 1720, 1380 and 1230 cm-1.

stem.label: spectrum 2
stem.alt: Infra-red spectrum 2: transmittance (%) against wavenumber (cm-1) from 4000 to 400, with a very broad absorption from about 3500 to 2500 cm-1 and a strong peak near 1720 cm-1.

stem.label: spectrum 3
stem.alt: Infra-red spectrum 3: transmittance (%) against wavenumber (cm-1) from 4000 to 400, with a broad O–H absorption near 3300 cm-1, no strong peak near 1720 cm-1, and strong peaks near 1100 cm-1.

stem.text: What could the three compounds be?
